canada.title: Nearly 2-month-old strike at Selkirk steel recycling plant could head to arbitration
canada.summary: Roughly 80 workers at a Selkirk, Man., recycling plant started striking Sept. 11, after negotiations for a new collective agreement faltered. If no deal is reached by next week, either party could apply for arbitration.

canada.summary: Organigram CEO James Yamanaka says the transaction is a defining step in the company's strategy to build a disciplined, global cannabis leader.

canada.title: Jasper to gain land-use authority after 30-year push
canada.summary: Parks Canada and the municipality of Jasper are working together to transfer land-use authority from the federal agency to local governance. Richard Ireland has spent 30 years fighting for local planning control, a battle sparked decades ago over perceptions that Banff mishandled its own development powers.

canada.summary: Esterhazy, Sask., was awoken by seismic activity Tuesday morning after a suspected mining-induced event triggered a tremor, Earthquakes Canada said.

canada.title: Trapped firefighters rescued from burning Oromocto home after roof collapsed
canada.summary: The Oromocto Fire Department says that two of its firefighters are recovering after being trapped in a burning building earlier this week.

canada.title: Lapu Lapu attack suspect pleads not guilty to all 42 charges
canada.summary: The BC Prosecution Service said that Kai Ji Adam Lo pleaded not guilty to 11 counts of second-degree murder and 31 counts of attempted murder during a court appearance on Monday.

canada.title: Masking is mandatory at N.L. health facilities, after uptick in respiratory illnesses and outbreaks
canada.summary: The province's health authority says the mask mandate is necessary due to "an increase in respiratory illnesses and outbreaks across Newfoundland and Labrador health Services facilities."

canada.title: Former officer accused in 3 sexual assault cases no longer employed by RCMP
canada.summary: The third case of sexual assault involving a former RCMP constable was dismissed on Monday after the Crown brought no evidence. The RCMP said Tuesday William McNutt, 41, is now no longer an employee.

canada.title: 3.4 magnitude earthquake near Esterhazy, Sask., likely caused by mining, Natural Resources Canada says
canada.summary: The earthquake — measured at a 3.4 magnitude — struck at 7:04 a.m. CST. Its epicentre was about nine kilometres east-northeast of Esterhazy, according to the NRC's Earthquake Canada website.

canada.title: 'Serious issue': family lawyer shortage forcing self-representation in Yukon courts
canada.summary: Yukoners don’t have sufficient access to lawyers generally, with 99 per cent of them concentrated in Whitehorse, states a 2024 report from the society. Still, the greatest demand for lawyers is in family law, followed by civil litigation, real estate, and wills and estates.

canada.title: Foodtastic makes takeover offer for MTY Food Group; MTY replaces CEO
canada.summary: Foodtastic's latest pitch comes two weeks after it said MTY rebuffed a prior takeover attempt. MTY launched a strategic review in 2025 after its stock faced pressure for rising prices, competition and economic volatility.

canada.title: Active remediation of Yukon’s Faro mine expected to begin in 2029
canada.summary: The active remediation of Yukon's Faro mine, considered to be one of the most contaminated mines in Canada, is expected to begin in 2029.

lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Prime Minister Mark Carney is in Antigua and Barbuda today for a meeting of Commonwealth heads of government, The Canadian Press reports.
Alberta Premier Danielle Smith is defending a proposal to redraw provincial boundaries in a way the Opposition NDP says is cheating.

The Bloc Québécois is making a budget request calling on Mark Carney’s government to double its benefit designed to help households cope with higher-than-ever prices on grocery store shelves, The Canadian Press reports.
The White House announced on Nov. 3 that representatives from Ukraine and Russia would join the first lady for her remarks on the humanitarian operation in Oleshky, Kyiv Independent reports.
A man convicted of murder who escaped from a Tennessee prison was recaptured on Tuesday in Missouri after more than a week on the run, authorities said.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
